Well-formed.story: I want to receive an error message after an invalid upload.
Well-formed.evidence: I want to receive an error message
Well-formed.rationale: The requested functionality is identifiable, but no stakeholder role is stated.

Atomic.story: As a traveler, I want to select a station on a map and see nearby hotels, so that I can plan my stay.
Atomic.evidence: select a station on a map and see nearby hotels
Atomic.rationale: Selecting a station and displaying nearby hotels are independently implementable features.

Minimal.story: As a shopper, I want to save an item for later, so that I can revisit it. Note: use a star icon and store the flag in local storage.
Minimal.evidence: Note: use a star icon and store the flag in local storage
Minimal.rationale: The story contains implementation notes beyond role, means, and optional ends.

Conceptually sound.story: As a visitor, I want to open the city map, so that I can display all restaurant markers.
Conceptually sound.evidence: so that I can display all restaurant markers
Conceptually sound.rationale: The ends clause introduces another requested feature instead of explaining the value of opening the map.

Problem-oriented.story: As an employee, I want to submit an expense claim using a green Save button in the upper-right corner, so that I can request reimbursement.
Problem-oriented.evidence: using a green Save button in the upper-right corner
Problem-oriented.rationale: The story prescribes a concrete UI solution rather than only the stakeholder need.

Unambiguous.story: As an editor, I want to update content, so that the page stays current.
Unambiguous.rationale: The term 'content' is underspecified and can refer to materially different information types.

context.story: As an editor, I want to edit any published article.

Conflict-free.story: As an editor, I want to edit only articles that I created.
Conflict-free.evidence: edit only articles that I created
Conflict-free.rationale: The target story restricts editing in a way that conflicts with DEMO-CF-A, which permits editing any published article.

Full sentence.rationale: The text is a noun phrase rather than a complete sentence.

Estimatable.story: As a driver, I want to see my route information, so that I can plan my day.
Estimatable.rationale: The scope is too vague to estimate because 'route information' could denote several substantially different capabilities.

context.story: As a reader, I want to view a list of news articles.

Unique.story: As a reader, I want to see the list of news articles.
Unique.evidence: see the list of news articles
Unique.rationale: The target story expresses the same requirement as DEMO-UQ-A without a meaningful difference.

context.story: As a visitor, I want to search events.
As a visitor, I want to view event details.

Uniform.story: Visitors receive event reminders by email.
Uniform.evidence: Visitors receive event reminders by email
Uniform.rationale: The target materially deviates from the dominant 'As a ..., I want to ...' template in the demo backlog.

context.story: As an admin, I want to create a customer profile.

Independent.story: As a clerk, I want to view a customer's profile, so that I can assist the customer.
Independent.rationale: The target inherently depends on customer profiles existing, which is established by DEMO-IN-A.

context.story: As an editor, I want to update an existing category.
As an editor, I want to delete an existing category.

Complete.story: As an editor, I want to delete an existing category.
Complete.rationale: The demo backlog operates on existing categories but contains no capability to create a category, exposing a missing complementary requirement.
